routing.purpose: Cross-surface proactive skill routing for Claude Code (UserPromptSubmit) and Cursor (beforeSubmitPrompt + always-apply rule). High-confidence routes reinforce native skill selection while preserving model judgment, explicit-only boundaries, and narrow composition. Recommendation never grants mutation authority.

routes.note: hint_allowed — Read Diagnose path after l9-pr-digest; remediate-until-green routes via pr_remediation_until_green (below) under packet bounds.

Invoking /l9-pr-remediation authorizes merge of all open PRs in the target repo after Converge (oldest-first, stack-safe). Subscribe/own every open PR through required checks; do not hand the watch back to the human. The per-PR board verdict comes from ops/autonomy/pr_board.py (required-check identity from branch protection plus rulesets, conflicted paths); an ownership class is the edit axis and never parks a PR; leftover requires --human-decision or --unfixable-check; above-paygrade leftovers open a GitHub issue and launch l9-issue-remediation — do not ask the human to unblock; mission is open_prs=0. Verify with make precommit-repo; publish with git push of the already-open PR branch. Do not run make pr or make pr-check. Campaigns/make pr stay no-merge. Force-push and admin-merge remain forbidden. Receipt: ops/autonomy/authorize_merge.py --all-open.

explicit_only + hint_allowed — /issues and /l9-issue-remediation are remediator Converge. Diagnose is /issues diagnose or “what’s blocking?” only and never chains /l9-pr-remediation. Converge verifies each issue is real, drains at max autonomy, asks recommended-A questions only for human/architecture blockers, lands fixes on matching or stacked PRs, closes status=fixed, and chains l9-pr-remediation only when open_issues=0.

Ordinary implementation plans, Build-button plans, and Cursor Plan mode are l9-plan-simple (planning-only; Build is the user's press). Campaign / PE / Program Lock planning is the campaign_plan route below — one manifest-owned doctrine, no static rule table (VSP-P1-002).
explicit_only + hint_allowed — the route recommends Read/attach (source: explicit_hint); it is never model-invocation authority. l9-plan-simple stays explicit_only so the Claude Code projection is unchanged by the Cursor plane (Claude Code Preservation Contract CC-006, V-CC-001). Promoting the tier is a separate change set — PR #512 owns it.
PE+autonomy planning that runs through program-execution. Live activation (make campaign INTENT=) stays pe_campaign_activate; this route plans, it never activates.

turn this workflow into a skill
add lint type checking and tests

explicit_only + hint_allowed — Read/attach only; human approve required for console.py --mode run. Recommendation grants no mutation authority.

explicit_only + hint_allowed — recommendation is routing evidence only (source: explicit_hint); requires /autonomy or explicit user campaign authority (campaign authorization packet). Never mutate from a hint alone.
explicit_only + hint_allowed — Read/attach only. Mutation is /ff or make ff via scripts/ff.sh. Never activate_fresh. Never delete unique work.
